ModMetaData.name: RimKéMoN
ModMetaData.author: RimGall
ModMetaData.description:
RimKéMoN turns RimWorld's animals and people into collectible battle monsters.
Link a colonist with the RimketLink, catch the creatures that roam your map, and fight turn-based battles inspired by the main-series games: gyms and the league, a Pokémon Center and mart, ranked battles, hunting runs, paradox battles with gene wedges, and online battles against other players.
Every animal gets its own level, tier, typing, ability and moves, and colonists can fight with stats drawn from their psylink and psychic sensitivity.
This is an unofficial fan mod. It is not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company; all rights to the original material belong to their respective owners.
[Credits] - PokeRogue (pagefaultgames): animated Pokémon sprites and shinies (pokerogue-assets), move animations, arenas, UI, balls, trainer art, BGM, sound effects, cries, Korean/English text, biome spawn tables, gym leader / Elite Four / champion teams - Generation 9 Pack v3.3.8 (Eevee Expo, eeveeexpo.com/resources/1101): species, move, ability and item data, evolution methods, item icons, overworld follower sprites, height data - Pokémon Feral F Sevii Update Gen9 Korean v0.4: door open/close and exclamation sound effects - pokefirered (pret decompilation): Pokémon Center and Poké Mart maps, tiles, NPCs, emoticons - PokeAPI: Korean names and descriptions (species, moves, abilities, items), Pokédex categories and entries - Bulbagarden Archives: HGSS / Pt trainer animations - github.com/coopscollectionbiz-debug/Poke-discord-bot: HGSS / Pt trainer animation GIF collection - Smogon usage statistics (github.com/pkmn/smogon): ranked opponent teams - Pokémon Champions rules and numbers reference: ChampDex, Serebii, Vandal, battlenest.jp - RimWorld (Ludeon Studios)
